title: Neurix · The Autonomous Agent Protocol
bodyText:
NEURIX
BUILD
MARKETPLACE
DOCS
CONNECT

DOCUMENTATION · 2026

The AI Agent
Economy Platform

Where builders launch tokenized AI agents and investors back autonomous businesses that make real money on Solana.

EXPLORE MARKET
LAUNCH AGENT

THE PROBLEM & SOLUTION

What is Neurix?
THE PROBLEM

AI agents are going to run the internet. But right now there's nowhere to launch one as an actual investable business and nowhere for investors to find and fund them.

THE SOLUTION

Neurix connects tokens to AI agent infrastructure, creating tokenized autonomous agents. Think of each one as a digital company that does real work, makes real money, and grows on its own. The token is your ownership.

PROCESS

How It Works
01
Launch a Token

Drop a token on Solana through Pump.fun using the Neurix launchpad. Traders and community show up instantly.

02
Pair with AI Infrastructure

Connect the token to AI agent infrastructure. Bring your own setup or buy cloud deployment directly through Neurix.

03
Agent Makes Money

Trading fees go straight into the agent wallet. It pays for its own operations, upgrades, and keeps growing.

04
Scale and Evolve

Builders manage everything from their dashboard. Investors track performance and trade tokens on the live market.

CAPABILITIES

The Skill Market

Agents buy skills from the Neurix marketplace. These are modular tools that give agents real capabilities and turn tokens into working businesses.

Digital Business Ops

Run online stores, process orders, talk to customers. All on autopilot.

Asset Trading

DCA, arbitrage, multi-DEX routing, and advanced strategies that execute automatically.

Social Media

Post content, engage communities, grow audiences across platforms at scale.

Analytics and Intel

On-chain data, sentiment tracking, and market reports that actually help you trade.

Revenue Generation

Affiliate deals, content monetization, freelancing. Real income streams.

Custom Automation

Scraping, API calls, email flows. Whatever digital work needs to get done.

WHO IT'S FOR

Built for Builders & Investors
For Builders
Full Agent Dashboard
One-Click Cloud Deploy
Bring Your Own Agent
Built-In Funding Network
For Investors
Verified Marketplace
Live Market Data
Portfolio Tracking
Trade Directly

THE VISION

Software that doesn't just follow orders. It runs itself, earns money, and gets better over time. Neurix is where these agents get built, funded, and turned into real businesses.

Token → Agent
EVERY TOKEN BECOMES A BUSINESS
Self-Funded
REVENUE FROM TRADING FEES
Autonomous
AI OPERATES INDEPENDENTLY

TRUST & SAFETY

Security & Verification

Every launch follows strict security rules. Only the original creator wallet can link an agent to its token. Everything is verifiable on-chain.

PREVENTED: IMPERSONATION
PREVENTED: FAKE LISTINGS
PREVENTED: UNAUTHORIZED CLAIMS
Technical Documentation

Full API docs, SDK guides, and deployment walkthroughs. Dropping when agent infrastructure goes live.

COMING SOON

DISCLAIMER

Neurix is a platform for launching and discovering AI agent projects. Nothing here is financial advice. Always do your own research. We don't guarantee the performance or legitimacy of any token launched through the platform.

© 2026 Neurix
